sentences.zh: 十九年，升桂陽縣為散州，割連州陽山縣來屬，為蒙古䴙忽都虎郡王分地，元隸湖南道宣慰司，後隸廣東道。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year Guiyang County was promoted to a scattered department; Yangshan County of Lian Prefecture was cut off and transferred to it; it became the allotted domain of the Mongol prince Qutuqutu; under the Yuan it was subordinate to the Hunan Circuit Pacification Commission, and later to the Guangdong Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In year 19 Guiyang County was elevated to a scattered department; Yangshan County was transferred from Lianzhou; it became the princely appanage of the Mongol prince Qutuqutu; under the Yuan it was under Hunan Circuit Pacification Commission, later Guangdong Circuit.

sentences.zh: 戶六千三百五十六，口二萬五千六百五十五。

translations.literal: Households numbered six thousand three hundred fifty-six, and persons twenty-five thousand six hundred fifty-five.
It administered one county:
Yangshan.
Lower grade.
Under Tang it was subordinate to Lian Prefecture; under Song it remained thus.
translations.idiomatic: Under Tang it belonged to Lianzhou; under Song it remained thus.

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan it was cut off and transferred here.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 19 it was transferred here.

translations.literal: Lian Department, lower grade.
Under Tang it was changed to Lianshan Commandery, then again changed to Lian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Under Tang it became Lianshan Commandery, then Lian Prefecture again.

sentences.zh: 元至元十三年，置安撫司，直隸行中書省。

translations.literal: In the Yuan, in the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan, a Pacification Office was established, directly subordinate to the Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 13 a Pacification Office was established, directly subordinate to the Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十七年，廢安撫司，升為連州路總管府，隸湖南道宣慰司。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year the Pacification Office was abolished; it was promoted to Lianzhou Circuit route commandery, subordinate to the Hunan Circuit Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In year 17 the Pacification Office was abolished; it became Lianzhou Circuit route commandery, under Hunan Circuit Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 十九年，降為散州，隸廣東道。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year it was reduced to a scattered department, subordinate to the Guangdong Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In year 19 it was reduced to a scattered department, under Guangdong Circuit.

sentences.zh: 戶四千一百五十四，口七千一百四十一。

translations.literal: Households numbered four thousand one hundred fifty-four, and persons seven thousand one hundred forty-one.
It administered one county:
Lianshan, lower grade.
Xun Department, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 唐改為海豐郡，仍改循州。

translations.literal: Under Tang it was changed to Haifeng Commandery, then again changed to Xun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Under Tang it became Haifeng Commandery, then Xunzhou again.

translations.literal: Under Song it was Boluo Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Under Song it was Boluo Commandery.

sentences.zh: 元至元十三年，立總管府。

translations.literal: In the Yuan, in the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan, a route commandery was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 13 a route commandery was established.

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year it was reduced to a scattered department.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23 it was reduced to a scattered department.

sentences.zh: 戶一千六百五十八，口八千二百九十。

translations.literal: Households numbered one thousand six hundred fifty-eight, and persons eight thousand two hundred ninety.
It administered three counties:
Longchuan, lower grade.
Xingning, lower grade.
Changle.
Lower grade.
